_README.title: US Major ETF Prices - Current Snapshot
_README.description: Lightweight current price snapshot for key US market ETFs (SPY/DIA/IWM/QQQ)
_README.purpose: Provide a small, easy-to-consume JSON for site widgets and pages that just need the latest ETF prices

notes.pricing_field: Price is the latest available intraday close from the most recent 5-minute bar.
notes.after_hours: After-hours and pre-market availability depends on Yahoo Finance; if unavailable, price may be null.

schema.data.{TICKER}.as_of: Timestamp (UTC) of the bar used for price
